name: Low-vol anomaly tilt — compressed-band calm hold (1d, spot)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the low-vol anomaly HOLDING tilt read through band compression + inverse-range rather than ATR — a distinct low-vol gauge so the tilt is not just a re-read of realized vol): 2025-2026 evidence (432 coins, Binance spot, 2018-2025) finds low-realized-vol coins deliver better risk-adjusted returns because leverage-averse retail crowds into high-vol lottery names and overpays, underpricing the calm names. Entry: bb_width below a fitted ceiling (bands compressed -> genuinely calm regime) AND vol_realized below a fitted ceiling (realized confirms calm) AND range_position mid-band (not extended). Hold through the calm to earn the premium the constrained crowd leaves behind. The counterparty is the degen buying the high-beta lottery ticket; the leverage constraint is why the mispricing survives. SPOT-only (matches the study, strips funding). Exit: bb_width crosses up (compression released, the calm regime ends) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if the tilt's excess return vanishes net of fees vs buy-and-hold BTC (the Gate's beat-B&H leg), it's disguised large-cap beta, not an orthogonal premium. DISCONFIRMER 2: if bb_width-ceiling and vol_realized-ceiling fire on the same bars >80% of the time they are one gauge, not two -> drop one and the 'independent confirmation' claim fails. DISCONFIRMER 3: a HIGH-vol tilt doing equally well over the same sample => unstable sign => curve-fit. Slow tilt -> include only if it clears B&H net.
catalyst: compressed-band calm name the leverage-averse crowd underprices
